messages.subject: Rowen | Energy, Mining & Sustainability Executive Profile | International Mobility
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Bainbridge,

I am sharing my profile for senior international assignments across energy, mining, natural resources and industrial businesses where government relations, ESG, corporate affairs and stakeholder strategy intersect.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My remit covers senior government and regulatory engagement, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, strategic partnerships, executive communications and cross-functional execution for a major gold-mining operation.

Your work across EMEA Board & CEO, energy transition, mining, commodities and sustainability makes my background relevant to searches where leaders must manage institutional relationships, social licence, reputation and transition priorities alongside operational growth.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head, Country Director and VP-track roles across External Affairs, Government Relations, Corporate Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships and Country Leadership. I am internationally mobile and available on 30 days' notice.

I have attached my global executive CV for confidential consideration.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
